decisions: Only the packed owner associates its verified inventory metadata reader with the original current source reader. Live selection scopes and qualified source reads use the latter; historical inventory/workflow/ledger JSON remain metadata only.
Source scopes retain their real physical binding guards, while the historical prepared.bound map records digests consumed by the historical metadata reader.

The inventory owner preserves its old compiled-function recipe as authenticated data, then checks the separately owned current packed source image. The finite tool owner accepts only the exact current inventory owner successor and retains both prior identities.

The retained historical live-source helper must also qualify these exact current tool references when validating its original implementation report. Keep that report and its historical source descriptors unchanged.
